name: linkedin_listed_blank_options_null_source_and_url
reason: Blank option texts are ignored, no board comes from source/url, so the default list's first entry LinkedIn is matched against the options: 'the first option whose text contains that board's words is returned (original text).'

name: linkedin_missing_indeed_listed_from_default_list
reason: 'then `default` — a board name such as "LinkedIn", or a LIST of board names tried in order (e.g. ["LinkedIn", "Indeed"])' — LinkedIn has no matching option, so the next default name Indeed matches.

name: board_list_but_neither_row_board_nor_linkedin_present
reason: 'If no option names any known board → null (it is not a job-board list). Otherwise try, in order, the row's board ... and then `default` ... null when neither is found.' — Glassdoor is a board so the list counts, but neither the row's board (none) nor LinkedIn/Indeed appear as options.

name: row_board_indeed_wins_over_linkedin_default
reason: 'Otherwise try, in order, the row's board (`board_of(source, url)`) and then `default`' — source 'indeed_search' names Indeed, which is tried before the default LinkedIn.

name: non_board_name_in_default_list_is_skipped
reason: 'a name that is not a known board is skipped' — 'Hired' is not one of the listed boards, so the default list continues to LinkedIn, which matches the option 'LinkedIn'.

name: empty_default_list_finds_nothing
reason: 'null when neither is found.' — the row's board is null and the empty default list supplies no names, even though the options name boards.

name: handshake_source_joinhandshake_matches_option
reason: 'Look at `source` ... first' and 'Handshake "handshake" or "joinhandshake"' — the row's board is Handshake, tried before the default LinkedIn.

name: linkedin_url_host_gives_board_matching_option_spelling_linked_in
reason: 'then the host part of `url` (scheme removed, everything after the first "/" dropped)' gives www.linkedin.com, i.e. board LinkedIn; 'LinkedIn "linked\s*in"' matches the option text 'Linked In', and 'the first option whose text contains that board's words is returned (original text).'

name: indeed_url_host_with_indeed_com_option_spelling
reason: 'Look at `source` ... first, then the host part of `url`' — host www.indeed.com names Indeed ('Indeed "indeed"'), so the option 'Indeed.com' containing that word is returned rather than ZipRecruiter, which is not the row's board (row's board is tried before `default` and only board words in options are matched).
